title: Jiuzhaigou's Autumn Colours Peak for Barely 3 Weeks | China Travel Expert
description:
Jiuzhaigou's autumn blaze is stunning — and it lasts barely three weeks.

Over 100 travertine lakes glow turquoise all year, but the gold-and-red foliage that frames them peaks only from about mid-October to early November. Come too early and the valley is still green; too late and the branches are bare. Miss the window and you wait a full year.

🧭 Expert Tip: Target roughly Oct 18–31 for peak colour, and skip the Oct 1–7 Golden Week crush, when the daily visitor cap fills fast.

九寨沟的秋色只红三周 —— 来早了全绿，来晚了全秃。
